_comment: Law 14 (balance cadence, CL.0 audit s4 / CL.6 lock). Hand-derived from the written lock; derivations in docs/audits/ds_1_kat_derivations.md. CG2 + CG3 are the DS.5.1 born-red witnesses: the pre-fix engine universe came from balance rows only, so an all-missing declared account and a transactions-only account were invisible.

vectors.name: CG1-explicit-daily-misses-middle-day
vectors.comment: Declared singleton on explicit_daily has rows d0 + d2, nothing d1; its own rows open the [d0,d2] frame.

vectors.name: CG2-declared-singleton-zero-rows-fires-whole-frame
vectors.comment: BORN-RED WITNESS (all-missing must alarm): X is DECLARED explicit_daily and appears in NEITHER feed; a sparse bystander opens a two-day frame; the declaration binds — X gaps both days.

vectors.name: CG3-transactions-only-sparse-activity
vectors.comment: BORN-RED WITNESS (sparse_with_activity's strongest case): T posts a leg on d0, never emits a balance row at all — activity with no close to reconcile against.

vectors.name: CG4-failed-only-activity-is-not-activity
vectors.comment: The existence predicate is status != Failed (operator-pinned, DS.3.3): a Failed-only account neither joins the universe nor counts as activity.

vectors.name: CG5-role-cadence-and-singleton-precedence
vectors.comment: Y (role R, explicit_daily by template) misses d2 of the [d1,d2] frame. Z shares role R but its SINGLETON declaration says sparse and Z has no d2 activity — the singleton wins (CL.0 Lock 3 ordering), so Z stays silent.

vectors.name: CG6-pending-counts-as-activity
vectors.comment: Sparse account S: d1 has a balance row + activity (no gap); d2 has a PENDING leg and no row — unknown/in-flight is still activity, corrupt or in-flight status cannot silence the alarm.

vectors.name: CG7-supersession-flows-through
vectors.comment: S's d2 leg is superseded Posted -> Failed (higher entry wins): the activity vanishes and the d2 gap with it. The d1 balance row superseded to a new money value is still a PRESENT claim — no gap either.

vectors.name: CG8-legs-alone-open-the-frame
vectors.comment: No balance rows exist ANYWHERE (the balance feed is broken entirely — the loudest failure): the frame opens from leg posting days alone and the sparse activity gap fires.

vectors.name: CG9-agreeing-emission-zeroes-the-residual
vectors.comment: Same state as CG1 with the detector emitting exactly the law's gap — symmetric difference empty.

vectors.name: CG10-external-scope-is-out-of-scope
vectors.comment: An external-scope account with activity and no balance row never enters the universe — the cadence contract binds internal accounts only.
